entries.title: Piecewise-Compensated High-PSRR Bandgap Reference
entries.desc:
• Implemented higher-order curvature correction using piecewise compensation technique to compensate for BJT non-idealities in Bandgap; achieved 4.4 ppm/°C Temperature Coefficient.
• Improved PSRR via cascode current mirrors; conducted full PVT corner verification across process, voltage, and temperature.

entries.title: Folded-Cascode OTA Tapeout
entries.desc:
• Designed a Folded-Cascode OTA in the GF180MCU-D PDK; submitted for GF180MCU test shuttle via TinyTapeout for silicon fabrication.
• Completed full pre-tapeout signoff: DRC, LVS, and PEX extraction.
